author: Maya R.
comment: Brisket was incredible: bark, smoke, all of it. Hosts made us feel like family even though we’d never met.

author: Chris L.
comment: Easy to find in Lot B, line moved fast, and the mac was unreal. Atmosphere was pure gameday.

comment: Great veggie options and compostable plates. Would love a second drink station next time.
